name: Resourceful Pursuit cuts the Rage cost of Tormentor and Damnation by 20% (#1307)
contract: Resourceful Pursuit 707648 reads 'Reduces the Rage cost of Tormentor and Damnation by $s1%.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive, family 21, effect 0 = SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), misc 14 = SPELLMOD_COST, BasePoints -21 (DieSides 1, so -20%), class mask (0x10000, 0, 0x10000000). Tormentor (800162, 501344-501355) has flag word 2 0x10000000 and cost 200, Damnation (520062, 520214-520217) has flag word 0 0x10000 and cost 250, both Rage, so SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost applies SPELLMOD_COST through Player::ApplySpellMod (SpellInfo.cpp:3074) and they cost 160 and 200 (Rage is stored in tenths). Smite Evil 802004 (flag word 1 0x40000000, cost 400) is outside the mask and is the control. The costs come from the spell_power_cost probe, which reads the native resource cost without submitting a cast; the pre-talent readings assert the DBC costs first so a drifting baseline fails loudly.
